body: The choice that keeps everyone comfortable may be the same choice that keeps your own preference out of the plan. When Lilith squares the North Node, a family expectation, relationship agreement, workplace norm, social rule, or version of respectability can keep demanding that you soften the decision until it no longer reflects what you wanted. Defiance alone will not build a better setup. Name the term you can no longer accept, then decide what you are prepared to change if the other side will not move with you.
